stem.text: A stone is released from rest and falls a long distance in air.
Which graph could show the variation with time $t$ of the acceleration $a$ of the stone?

A.alt: Graph of a against t with axes labelled a and t and the origin marked 0; a curve drawn from the origin.

B.alt: Graph of a against t with axes labelled a and t and the origin marked 0; a straight line drawn from the vertical axis to the horizontal axis.

C.alt: Graph of a against t with axes labelled a and t and the origin marked 0; a horizontal line drawn above the horizontal axis.

D.alt: Graph of a against t with axes labelled a and t and the origin marked 0; a curve drawn from the vertical axis to the horizontal axis.
